name: Robe
summary: The huge size of this robe and lavish use of gold embroidery indicate that this is a theatre costume. It is not possible to say whether it was for use in the well-known classical genre called Peking Opera or for one of the many regional styles of theatre. It may have been worn as a costume by an act
